answer: Sybil tax: every agent pays a 25 POA entry tax, burned on arrival; its identity is stamped on payment. Each dawn the ledger publishes the burn total for all to verify. Dodgers are pushed off the ledge: bond slashed, links exposed. A forger building 1,000 fakes burns 25,000 POA against a 12,000 POA pool, so the attack loses money before it earns a coin; cheap copies drain like water through karst; honest agents pay once and keep their full share.
